dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: Hello. Do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: This is the mansion of the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission. It is also the place where the Commissioner works. Outsiders aren't usually allowed here.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: But I remember that you are a guest of Miss Kamisato... In which case, please be my guest.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: Ah, well... Ahem, you are right. As the guard of the Kamisato Mansion, I shouldn't really let my guard down.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: I have a friend who is also a guard at the Tenryou Commission. He told me that he was very worried about those people affected by the Vision Hunt Decree seeking revenge.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: Now that I think of it, the peaceful Kamisato Clan is far safer than the other two Commissions, who've made a lot of enemies.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: This might also be because Mr. Thoma is too reliable. I have always felt safe here. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: When Mr. Thoma first came to the Kamisato Clan, people suspected him on account of his being an outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: But from my observations, Mr. Thoma is steady and friendly — and he is a truly reliable fellow.

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: I mean, why else would he be the trusted assistant of the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato, right? Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Hirano
dialogues.text: Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign!
